raw.name: Hard Bone

dictionary.lore: This extremely hard material is said to be the fossil of an ancient demon. It holds the combat instincts of the demon within, and is used in making Aries' Flute. It's nearly nonexistent in Elgaia, yet rumor has is that elemental spirits and statues drop them from time to time.
